entities.summary: Major General Edmund Alfred Drake-Brockman, was an Australian soldier, politician, and judge. He served in both the First and Second World Wars. He was a senator for Western Australia from 1920 to 1926, representing the Nationalist Party, and later served as a judge of the Commonwealth Court of Conciliation and Arbitration from 1927 until his death in 1949.
